title: Senior Analytics / Data Engineer - Enterprise Data Platform
description:
🌀 The Company Filigran, founded in October 2022, stands out in the cybertech ecosystem for its commitment to revolutionizing cyber threat management with a proactive approach. Its mission is to develop innovative open-source solutions designed to anticipate cyber threats, identify security gaps, and strengthen organizational security posture.
 Filigran solutions are now trusted by over 6,000 public and private organizations worldwide.
 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Senior Analytics / Data Engineer to join our Data team and take ownership of Filigran's Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) end-to-end — from ingestion to consumption. This is a senior, hands-on role: you turn raw data from across the company into reliable pipelines, trusted models, and governed, high-quality data that every team can rely on to make decisions.

You'll also need enough Data Engineering skill to maintain and troubleshoot ingestion pipelines when they break, and a Data Analyst / BI mindset is a valuable bonus to help teams turn data into KPIs and dashboards.
 You'll collaborate with virtually every team at Filigran (Sales, Finance, Product, Engineering, Support, People) in a fully remote, high-trust, async-first environment. This is a highly cross-functional role, and you'll help the whole company become more data-driven.

 Model and transform data with dbt, following a clean staging → intermediate → marts architecture.
 Own data quality, reliability and observability: testing, monitoring, alerting on data issues, code reviews.
 Maintain the data catalog and governance so data stays discoverable, understood, trusted and well-documented.
 Build and maintain dashboards in Metabase that give teams clear, trustworthy visibility into their KPIs.

description:
WIR suchen dich! Statt nur Code zu schreiben, möchtest du sehen, wie deine Arbeit wirkt? Gemeinsam mit fünf Analytics- und Data-Expert*innen entwickelst du in Bonn moderne Datenlösungen für ein ganzheitliches 360°-Kundenprofil und ermöglichst damit datengetriebene Entscheidungen, die zu mehr Inklusion und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe beitragen.
 Tu, was du liebst Du arbeitest an modernen Datenprodukten, die Reporting, Analysen und datengetriebene Entscheidungen in der Aktion Mensch unterstützen. Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von Standards für Datenqualität, Governance und Wiederverwendbarkeit von Daten.
 Zeig, was du kannst Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Data Engineering gesammelt, beispielsweise durch Berufserfahrung, Studium, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder eigene Projekte. Du hast erste Erfahrungen mit Datenpipelines, ETL-/ELT-Prozessen oder vergleichbaren Datenintegrationsaufgaben. Wünschenswert sind erste Kenntnisse in Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services oder vergleichbaren Cloud- und Datenplattformen. title: Data Engineer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role 

The Data Engineering team builds and operates the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, and data-driven products across Nebius. We ingest data from internal and external systems, develop reliable transformation pipelines and data models, and make trusted datasets available to business and product teams.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own substantial parts of our data platform and deliver complex data products end to end. You will turn ambiguous business needs into pragmatic technical solutions, make architecture and implementation trade-offs, and improve the reliability, scalability, and usability of our data ecosystem.

You will work closely with product, platform, and business teams, helping them use data effectively while ensuring that our systems remain maintainable and trustworthy as Nebius grows.

Your responsibilities
